title: Frau Wirtin hat auch eine Nichte
writer: Günter Ebert, Kurt Nachmann, Vittoria Vigorelli
actors: Teri Tordai, Claudio Brook, Margaret Lee
plot: Susanna travels to Paris with her small group of actors. There she saves Emperor Napoleon from rather painful predicaments, uncovers a number of nasty court intrigues and finds, with much skill and ability, the man of her choice.
